response.courseDescription: 410 [M] Bioengineering Capstone Project I Part I of capstone engineering design project; problem definition, design requirements, conceptual design, detail design, and technical writing and presentation.
response.coursePrerequisites: BIO ENG 305, BIO ENG 350, and BIO ENG 360, each with a C or better; BIO ENG 456 or BIO ENG 475, OR BIO ENG 420 and BIO ENG 430, each with a C or better or concurrent enrollment; admitted to the major in Bioengineering.
